stages.breaks: You sell it before you have a baseline.
stages.why: A client told that AI search will help, with nothing measured, cannot judge it later.
stages.does: We run the visibility check first, in your template, so the pitch and the progress both start from evidence.

stages.breaks: Pages open with the story, not the answer.
stages.why: AI tools and search favour pages that reply first and explain after.
stages.does: Priority pages are rewritten to lead with a direct answer, and an editor reviews them against your tone notes.

stages.breaks: FAQ schema does not match what the page says.
stages.why: Markup that disagrees with the visible page is ignored at best and a risk at worst.
stages.does: FAQs are real questions answered on the page, with structured data validated and shown to you before launch.

stages.breaks: The client is described only by its own site.
stages.why: Tools draw on more than one source, so a brand with no outside mentions is easy to skip.
stages.does: We build citations on sources tools commonly use and log each one for your report.

stages.breaks: The report promises a result nobody can guarantee.
stages.why: No one controls what an AI tool says, so a promised outcome sets you up to miss.
stages.does: We report mentions and answer features over time and add an honest note on what moved, so you never overpromise.
